meta.title: WatchCompare
meta.tagline: Find the best watch deals across Chrono24, eBay and top dealers in Tokyo and Taipei
meta.description: Compare luxury watch prices across marketplaces in Taiwan, Japan, Europe and the US. Search by brand, reference or budget and see every listing in your currency.

home.heroSubtitle: We index {count} watches from {sources} marketplaces every night and show them in your currency, so you can spot the best deal for a brand, a reference or a budget.
home.how1Body: Every night at 02:00 (Taipei) we visit each marketplace, index new listings and retire sold ones.
home.how2Body: Brands, references, conditions and prices are unified so a listing in Tokyo compares with one in Munich.
home.how3Body: Prices convert with daily exchange rates. The original price and a link to the seller are always one click away.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: WatchCompare is a price-comparison index for watches. This policy explains what the website and the WatchCompare iOS app collect, and what they do not. The short version: no accounts, no advertising, anonymous usage statistics only, and nothing about you is sold or shared.
scopeBody: This policy applies to the WatchCompare website and the WatchCompare app for iPhone and iPad. Both read from the same public listing index. Marketplaces and sellers we link to have their own privacy policies.
collectBody: Server logs. When you load a page or the app requests data, our hosting providers (Vercel for the website, Google Cloud Run for the API) record standard request logs: your IP address, the page or endpoint requested, the time, and your browser or app version. We use these only to keep the service running and to diagnose problems. Logs are kept for up to 30 days and then deleted.

Usage analytics. We use Amplitude to count searches and listing views on the website and in the app, so we can see which brands, references and marketplaces people look for. Each event carries the search terms and filters or the listing opened, your display currency and language, the platform, a random identifier for your browser or device, and a coarse location that Amplitude derives from your IP address. Events never contain a name, e-mail address or advertising identifier. Amplitude stores them on our behalf in the United States under its own privacy policy.

Preferences. The website stores your chosen display currency and language in cookies so that pages render in your currency on the next visit. These cookies contain no identifier and are not used for tracking. Your recent searches are saved in your browser's local storage so they can be suggested again; they never leave your device.

The iOS app stores the same preferences (display currency and recent searches) on your device only. The app sends the search filters you choose to our API in order to return results; it does not send your name, contacts, location, photos or device identifiers.

Tracking permission (iOS app). The app asks once, through Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt, whether it may track your activity across other companies' apps and websites. Nothing is tracked unless you allow it, and you can change your answer at any time under Settings › Privacy & Security › Tracking. In the app, the usage analytics described above are only sent if you allow this; if you decline, the app records nothing.
notCollectBody: There are no user accounts, so we hold no names, e-mail addresses or passwords. Beyond the usage analytics described above we use no advertising or tracking SDKs, no fingerprinting and no cross-site cookies. We do not sell, rent or share any data with third parties for their own purposes.
thirdPartiesBody: Listing photos are loaded directly from the marketplace that published the listing (for example Chrono24, eBay or a dealer's own site). When your browser or the app fetches a photo, that marketplace's servers see your IP address and standard request information, just as if you visited their site.
When you follow a link to a seller, you leave WatchCompare and the seller's terms and privacy policy apply.
The website is hosted on Vercel and the API on Google Cloud (region asia-east1, Taiwan). Both providers process request data on our behalf under their own privacy commitments.
choicesBody: You can clear the currency and language cookies and the recent-search history at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser. In the app, use “Clear” next to Recent searches, or delete the app to remove all of its stored preferences. Because we keep no account data, there is nothing else to export or delete; if you believe a log entry concerns you, contact us and we will help.
childrenBody: WatchCompare is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect any information from them.
changesBody: If we change how the website or the app handles data, we will update this page and the date at the top.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Help for the WatchCompare website and the WatchCompare app for iPhone and iPad.
support.contactBody: Found a wrong price, a listing that should not be there, or a bug? Email us and include the listing link or a screenshot if you can.
support.issuesBody: Developers can also report problems or suggest sources on
support.responseTime: We usually reply within two working days.

faq.outdatedQ: A listing says it is no longer available.
faq.outdatedA: We re-index every marketplace once a night (02:00 Taipei time). A watch sold during the day stays visible until the next crawl, and is then marked unavailable. The seller's page is always the source of truth.
faq.priceQ: The price shown differs from the seller's page.
faq.priceA: Prices are converted with daily exchange rates and rounded, and Japanese dealers are shown at the tax-free amount used for export. Tap through to the seller for the exact price, tax and shipping.
faq.currencyQ: How do I change the currency or language?
faq.currencyA: On the website use the menus in the header. In the app, open Settings for the currency; the language follows your iOS language setting.
faq.wrongDataQ: A listing has the wrong brand, reference or condition.
faq.wrongDataA: Details are extracted automatically from the seller's page and normalized, so mistakes happen. Email us the listing link and we will fix the rule that caused it.
faq.sourcesQ: Can you add a marketplace or dealer?
faq.sourcesA: Possibly. We only index sites whose terms allow it. Send us the site and we will take a look.
faq.dataQ: What do you store about me?
faq.dataA: No account, no advertising. Your currency choice and recent searches stay on your device. Searches and listing views are counted anonymously with Amplitude so we can see what people look for. See the privacy policy for the full picture.
